description: MathWorks publishes this triplex-pump model for simulating mechanical, hydraulic and electrical behaviour and component faults. Three plungers share a crankshaft with phases separated by 120 degrees. MATLAB parameters allow resizing, with defaults based on the CAT Pumps 1051 and a provider housing geometry. Users configure pump parameters and failures, then obtain simulated behaviour suitable for synthetic predictive-maintenance data. Coverage is global at an equipment component, with duration and sampling set by the project. Repository source is publicly available at no charge under custom MathWorks terms permitting redistribution but restricting use and derivatives to MathWorks products and services. Required MATLAB/Simscape products have separate costs. A limitation is that the model's seal leakage, inlet blockage, bearing wear and winding faults do not establish validated diagnosis for every real pump. The README documents opening the project and reusing simulation results. It supports equipment-condition studies alongside water-network simulation in EPANET (model-epanet). No project archive or CAD geometry was downloaded.
